Responsibilities:

* Employ core technologies and agile development methodologies in vogue in
the current team
* Participate in server-side development activity for back-end Java-based
services using REST, SOAP or related protocols
* Collaborate with business analysts, other developers, and QA team members
to build and deploy applications in support of business and technical in
* Proficiency in Java development, RESTful service development, JUnit, SQL,
and experience with database technologies such as Oracle

SVN/GIT/Perforce, Maven

extremely tight deadline sedatives.

Qualifications
* A BS or BA in Computer Science or Information Technology
* Minimum of 8 years of development experience
* Financial service experience and knowledge of exchange traded derivatives
and fixed income products strongly preferred.
